# Within reach image prompt

Reconstructed production template, **not a recovered historical prompt**. Use with [STYLE-SYSTEM.md](../STYLE-SYSTEM.md), [tokens](../../design/within-reach/style-tokens.json) and [manifest](../../design/within-reach/asset-manifest.json). No new generation is required merely to establish this contract.

## Before calling the tool

Reuse an approved component when it fits. Otherwise visually inspect the master and closest approved component, then attach **both actual files** as editing references. With `image_gen.imagegen`, use `referenced_image_paths` for available local files; inspect them with `view_image` first. For component output set `transparent_background: true`. Save the complete executed prompt, not just this template. Generate one sample and review it in the scene before batching.

## Fixed style block — retain across lessons

> Use the attached Within reach master as the controlling visual reference and the attached approved component for continuity of drawing and material. Create tactile cut-paper editorial illustration: saturated lemon stage context, ultramarine structural shapes, near-black ink/clothing, ivory light paper and sparing vivid orange accents. Broad angular silhouettes, irregular clipped paper edges, dense fine paper grain, creases, scuffs and small scratched highlights. Restrained paper thickness and shallow contact shadows. Recognisable subjects reduced to bold planes; no elaborate setting. People have expressive asymmetry, angular features and articulated oversized hands, with gesture carrying the idea. Match the references' physical paper finish and level of detail. Preserve an existing character's identity when editing its pose. New characters may have different identities and bodies within the same drawing grammar.

## Variable subject/action block — fill explicitly

> Deliverable: [one isolated component / a scene study]. Subject: [recognisable subject and essential features]. Action/pose: [specific gesture, direction of gaze, limb positions, contact points]. Teaching meaning: [what the action reveals; do not invent numerical implications]. Existing scene neighbours: [assets and relative scale]. Composition: [orientation, clear silhouette, empty space needed, fully visible extremities]. Palette roles: [which approved colours belong to which parts]. Separate moving elements: [list; exclude these from baked artwork]. For an isolated component: output real alpha transparency, no stage or background pixels; retain only restrained local paper shading. For a scene study: use the approved lemon paper stage. Generate no labels, numbers or UI text; these will be added separately.

## No-go block — retain

> No generic SVG/icon aesthetic, smooth vector shapes, rounded corporate cartoon, glossy 3D clay, photoreal anatomy, woodcut/screenprint treatment, literal miniature street, elaborate machinery, deep cinematic lighting, broad background glow or opaque/checkerboard fake transparency. No generated text, digits, denominations, logos, controls or labels. No baked moving payment, duplicated cash, cropped hands/feet or accidental additional limbs. Do not mix the archived woodcut or sculpture alternatives into this style.

## Record and review

Save exact prompt/revisions, all reference paths and hashes, returned generation identifiers, tool name, exposed model/version/settings (unknown when unavailable), date, output path and alpha check. Keep originals and production copies distinct. Compare the sample with the master **inside the scene** at desktop and phone sizes using the screenshot rubric. Log corrections before further generation. References and QA improve consistency; stochastic generation cannot promise identical pixels across chats.
